activity.notes: Jinheung was the 24th king of Silla and reigned from 540 to 576. His reign saw major territorial expansion, including control of the Han River basin, and is a central phase in Silla's rise. ATLAS records the sovereign reign only.

sources.title: 진흥왕 — 한국민족문화대백과사전
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture identifies Jinheung as Silla's 24th king and gives his reign as 540–576.
